items.reason: Five registered EXPERIMENTAL arms (dose escalation plus four expansion cohorts), none acting as a control; manual R8 reserves not_applicable for single-arm trials and gives 'no' for more than one arm with no control.

The brief summary plans to assess 'pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and the preliminary antitumor activity of TAS2940', a PD objective tied to the candidate; manual W7 keeps 'unclear' for biomarker endpoints not linked to the candidate. But no PD measure or sample is registered, so this is a judgement call.

note: target_engagement: a PD objective named with no measurement described is not settled by W7; the same question arises in NCT04430842 and NCT04195555 in this batch and should get one convention. Primary outcome: both coders code EGFR/HER2 as candidate-matched eligibility (title: 'Solid Tumors With EGFR and / or HER2 Aberrations'; 'Any solid tumor with EGFR and / or HER2 aberration' for escalation), so candidate_matched_selection = true either way, but the GBM expansion criterion 'Cohort C: Recurrent or refractory glioblastoma' does not restate the EGFR/HER2 requirement; this positive match goes to D21 review anyway.
